name: Dark Blood cuts Cursed Form costs and raises Blood Rituals healing (#3447)
contract: Dark Blood ships two ranks, 804807 and 807919, both SpellFamilyName 26. Effect 0 of each is aura 108 with MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST), BasePoints -26 -> -25% (rank 1) and -51 -> -50% (rank 2), over EffectSpellClassMask (16777216, 9437185, 67127433), which selects the Cursed Form kit including the ten Bloodfang Bite records (501695-501697, 503613-503615, 572549-572551, 800156). Effect 1 of each is aura 108 with MiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), +25% / +50%, over (0, 0, 512) = word 2 bit 9 = Blood Rituals 704119, whose effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL; Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone applies SPELLMOD_DAMAGE to direct healing. Tooltip: "Reduces the cost of your abilities that require Cursed Form and increases the healing done by Blood Rituals by $s1%." Both ranks are asserted separately, with the first unlearned before the second so the two modifiers never coexist. Regression guard for native behaviour.

steps.label: Bloodfang Bite costs its authored amount before the talent
Blood Rituals heals its authored amount before the talent
Rank 1 cuts Bloodfang Bite's cost by 25%
Rank 1 raises Blood Rituals healing by 25%
Rank 2 cuts Bloodfang Bite's cost by 50%
Rank 2 raises Blood Rituals healing by 50%
Dark Blood does not touch Bloodbolt's cost
